findings.claim: Walmart Q4 FY26 全球電商成長 24%，由店配取貨／配送與 marketplace 帶動；全年全球廣告業務（含 VIZIO）成長 46% 至近 64 億美元；會員費收入 Q4 全球成長 15.1%（二手摘要，數字出自 2026-02-19 財報）
findings.source: Walmart Q4 FY26 earnings release (Business Wire, 2026-02-19) via galvnews.com; Nasdaq/Zacks 'Walmart's Ad Business Jumps 37%'

findings.claim: 廣告加會員合計占 Q4 營業利益近三分之一（Nasdaq/Zacks 分析）；Q2 FY26 marketplace 銷售成長 17%，約 44% 量經 WFS
findings.source: Nasdaq/Zacks, Walmart's Ad Business Jumps 37%: Margin Upside Ahead?; Zacks, Walmart's Marketplace Gains Speed

findings.claim: FY26 Q1：全球廣告成長 50%（含 Vizio），不含 Vizio 為 27%，Walmart Connect 成長 31%；廣告加會員約占公司利潤四分之一；加拿大會員方案改名 Walmart+
findings.source: MarketingDive via 8thandwalton.com, 'Walmart's advertising business soars with Vizio integration'
findings.excerpt: Walmart's global advertising business grew 50% year over year in the retailer's fiscal Q1 2026, boosted by the integration of connected TV device maker Vizio. Stripping out Vizio, the ad segment was up 27% YoY; Walmart Connect, the retailer's U.S. retail media arm that does not yet include Vizio, increased ad sales 31% YoY in Q1.

note: 搜尋僅 2 次；未找到 FY27 最新季（2026-08）資料與實體配銷網路改變證據；摘要為二手彙整，excerpt 僅最後一條可視為逐字。
